##### Random Network FFRCISTG

The random network finest fully randomized causally interpretable structured tree graph (RNFFRCISTG) is a causal model of a random network NPSEM that satisfies (1) no contagion, (2) homogeneous random network interference, with respect to the graph generators in the model, (3) identical structural distributions and (4) single-world independence, with each graph generator taken as a single variable (@def-rnffrcitg). No contagion restricts the DAG; homogeneous random network interference and identical structural distributions are statistical assumptions; single-world independence is the causal one. Because each graph generator is one variable, nothing is assumed about how edges within it depend on each other, and the network's law is seen at one past only.
